decisions.reason: The margin analysis has its own page and extends the established market-data offer, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing industry and needs no problemistic search.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core business and draws on maintained databases at low marginal cost, so available slack easily carries it.

Dropping C shows that the firm consolidates overlapping tariff calculators, which raises the risk for this lower-visibility line, but its several models and integration into the platform still favour keeping it.
The area definition tool complements the location-based products and the central platform, so its value to the portfolio justifies keeping it.
The site-specific comparison line uses existing data close to the core offer, so despite modest web visibility, slack and market growth support retaining it.
